title: Adobe Creative Suite MCP — Agentic control of Photoshop and Premiere Pro
description: MCP server enabling Claude to control Adobe Photoshop and Premiere Pro via natural language. Demonstrated capabilities include layer manipulation, color grading, export automation, and video timeline editing. No existing equivalent in registry: Canva MCP (rejected, 54/100) targets web-based design; Blender MCP covers 3D; Figma MCP targets UI design. This targets professional photo/video editing workflows directly from Claude Code. Relevant for game asset pipeline (<private-project>-gacha) and Ashita Orbis image processing.
notes: HN item ID 43613545 is lower than typical March 2026 IDs — may be from early 2025 rather than the past 7 days. Surfaced via March 2026 search results but recency unconfirmed.
